Facts:
- In the early 1990s, during the breakup of the Soviet Union, “Babyflot” became the informal name for airlines in the former Soviet Union that were created from the dissolution of the Aeroflot monopoly.
- Aeroflot is formally named PJSC Aeroflot–Russian Airlines.
- Aeroflot is the flag carrier and largest airline of the Russian Federation.
- Aeroflot is an open joint stock company that operates domestic and international passenger services mainly from its hub at Sheremetyevo International Airport.
- Moscow Airways was a Russian airline formed as a subsidiary of Aeroflot to operate Aeroflot’s Ilyushin Il-62 fleet.
